non_claims: Hydroxyl and methoxyl positions beyond the hypothesis scaffold are not resolved
Free aglycone versus an in-source aglycone ion of a conjugate is not decided by this rule
Anthocyanidin [M]+ ions isobaric with a flavonol [M+H]+ (cyanidin and kaempferol) are not excluded by the precondition

For quercetin the (1,3B+)-2H formula is C8H5O3+: by calculation C8H5O3+ (149.0233) is also protonated phthalic anhydride, the usual fragment of phthalate plasticizers, so a co-isolated phthalate can supply this claim ion (inference, not from a cited source)
Precursors at the other common positive adducts tried under adduct_ambiguous ([M+NH4]+, [M+Na]+, [M+K]+) are not described by the cited [M+H]+ fragmentation

notes: Flavonol aglycone [M+H]+: 1,3A+ with (1,3B+)-2H and 0,2A+, ions that CID of standards gave for flavonols and not for flavones (Ma 1997); (1,4A+)+2H is reported as an upgrade only.

terms.note: 1,3A+ of a 5,7-dihydroxy A ring; also Jiang 2024 and Zhang 2026; shared by flavones and flavanones, so not a claim term
0,2A+ for all four flavonols and not for flavones (Ma 1997); Jiang 2024 print C8H5O4+ for kaempferol and isorhamnetin, Tsimogiannis 2007 and Zhang 2026 for kaempferol and quercetin
(1,3B+)-2H, which flavonols give in place of the intact 1,3B+ of flavones (Ma 1997); Jiang 2024 list C8H5O2+ for kaempferol unassigned, Tsimogiannis 2007 print 133 and 149 labelled 1,3B+

(1,4A+)+2H for all four flavonols at 1.4-14 % (Ma 1997), an upgrade only: no source shows flavones lack it, van der Hooft 2011 report C6H7O3+ only as a minor morin-specific ion, Jiang 2024 Tables A5-A6 do not list it, and by calculation it is also the formula of hexose dehydration ions
